4: %   backbone (caseID, fault_location, fault_type) study-backup row (40 rows)

7: %     fault_location, fault_type, caseID, primary_function,
8: %     primary_availability, primary_time_s, backup_function, backup_time_s,
9: %     ct_source, setting_source, detection, determinable, not_determinable.
10: %   primary_availability / detection vocabulary is locked to

12: %   detection; not_determinable always carries text (blocking or
13: %   residual-limitation reasons); ct_source / setting_source always carry
14: %   traceability text.
15: %
16: %   RUNTIME (binding carry-over 1): phase5b_branch_phasors(T40) is called
17: %   ONCE per invocation (takes ~5 min on the 40-row backbone: one frozen
18: %   phase4_contrib re-solve per row plus the 1e-6 identity gate against the
19: %   production contributions CSV). The resulting B table is reused across
20: %   all 48 rows below; no .mat caching (determinism first).
21: %
22: %   INWARD-FLOW JUSTIFICATION (locked detection rule): internal fault + max
23: %   terminal branch >= sourced pickup -> ASSERTABLE-DETECT; else
24: %   NOT-DETERMINABLE, never invented. Every B leg magnitude derives from the
25: %   frozen phase4_contrib legs re-signed TOWARD THE FAULT (phase4_contrib.m
26: %   header lines 20-35: every leg re-signed toward the fault, then
27: %   phase-reconstructed per leg with Fortescue), so at an internal fault
28: %   every zone terminal feeds inward and the differential sum is the
29: %   magnitude sum. GEN-87G detection is therefore assertable exactly when
30: %   the GEN terminal faulted-phase branch meets the sourced 87G pickup
31: %   (0.20 x 12019 = 2403.8 A from the GEN-87G registry row,

44: %   inward magnitude observation (F3: GSUT_HV + LINE_total + GRID infeeds;

49: %   F4 DOCTRINE (binding carry-over 2): at F4 the B1/B2 leg rows are used,
50: %   never the LINE_total cancellation residual (~1e-13 kA at LL/LLG, where
51: %   the two toward-fault infeeds cancel in the unfaulted-phase sum). The

360: function c = as_lines(v, nm)
361: %AS_LINES  Normalize a cellstr/string/char setting block to cellstr.
362: if isstring(v), v = cellstr(v(:)); end
363: if ischar(v), v = cellstr(v); end
364: if ~iscell(v) || isempty(v)
365:     error('phase5b_writer:args', '%s must be a non-empty cellstr.', nm);
366: end
367: c = v(:)';
368: for k = 1:numel(c)
369:     if isstring(c{k}) && isscalar(c{k}), c{k} = char(c{k}); end
370:     if ~ischar(c{k})
371:         error('phase5b_writer:args', '%s entries must be char/string.', nm);
372:     end
373: end
374: end

376: function assert_ledger(T, tname, col)
377: %ASSERT_LEDGER  Column present + every row non-empty (provenance full close).
378: if ~any(strcmp(T.Properties.VariableNames, col))
379:     error('phase5b_writer:schema', 'tables.%s missing required column %s.', tname, col);
380: end
381: v = T.(col);
382: ok = true;
383: if iscell(v)
384:     for i = 1:numel(v)
385:         vv = v{i};
386:         if isstring(vv) && isscalar(vv), vv = char(vv); end
387:         if ~ischar(vv) || isempty(strtrim(vv)), ok = false; break; end
388:     end
389: elseif isstring(v)
390:     for i = 1:numel(v)
391:         if strlength(strtrim(v(i))) == 0, ok = false; break; end
392:     end
393: elseif ischar(v)
394:     if isempty(strtrim(v)), ok = false; end
395: else
396:     ok = false;
397: end
398: if ~ok
399:     error('phase5b_writer:provenance', ...
400:         'tables.%s has an empty %s cell (every row needs provenance + scope traceability).', tname, col);
401: end
402: end

404: function assert_whitelist(T, tname)
405: %ASSERT_WHITELIST  Provenance class whitelist (error otherwise).
406: %   Legal classes: SOURCE-BACKED / DERIVED / ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION /
407: %   LEGACY / MISSING / USER_ASSERTED_PENDING_DOC (checked as the prefix
408: %   before ':'). assumption_class values are never rejected here, and
409: %   assumption_class PRIMARY on PHYSICAL registry rows is explicitly legal
410: %   (C3 concern resolved: yes).
411: legal = {'SOURCE-BACKED', 'DERIVED', 'ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION', ...
412:     'LEGACY', 'MISSING', 'USER_ASSERTED_PENDING_DOC'};
413: v = T.provenance;
414: for i = 1:numel(v)
415:     vv = v{i};
416:     if isstring(vv) && isscalar(vv), vv = char(vv); end
417:     if ~ischar(vv)
418:         error('phase5b_writer:provenance', ...
419:             'tables.%s provenance row %d is not text (whitelist cannot be checked).', tname, i);
420:     end
421:     cls = strtok(vv, ':');
422:     if ~any(strcmp(strtrim(cls), legal))

475: function Trc = relay_currents_table_v2(Mtrx, TiJ)
476: %RELAY_CURRENTS_TABLE_V2  One row per finite matrix side + I0 context.
477: %   I_primary = I_secondary x CT_device (matrix sides are secondary amperes;
478: %   CTs are v2 15000/1600 via the graded matrix). Secondary arithmetic is
479: %   frozen phase5_ct (the single source of truth; the phase5_ct_table
480: %   wrapper rejects 1600 by locked guard and frozen files stay untouched).
481: %   I0_A joins real production Iseq0; LG-exact If/3 only when the join
482: %   truly lacks I0; LLG-without-Iseq0 -> NaN, never invented.
483: ml = tocell(Mtrx.fault_location); mt = tocell(Mtrx.fault_type); mc = tocell(Mtrx.caseID);
484: jl = tocell(TiJ.fault_location); jt = tocell(TiJ.fault_type); jc = tocell(TiJ.caseID);
485: Jseq = double(TiJ.Iseq0_kA(:)); Jtot = double(TiJ.I_primary_A(:));
486: oLoc = {}; oTyp = {}; oCase = {}; oDev = {}; oSide = {};
487: oIp = []; oIk = []; oCt = []; oIs = []; oI0 = []; oSrc = {};
488: oProv = {}; oScope = {};
489: PROV = ['SOURCE-BACKED:Phase-4-production-import-branch-through-current-via-frozen-phase5_coord;' ...
490:     'secondaries-via-frozen-phase5_ct-arithmetic-v2-CTs-15000-gen-1600-GSUT-GIS'];
491: for i = 1:height(Mtrx)
492:     j = find(strcmp(jc, mc{i}) & strcmp(jl, ml{i}) & strcmp(jt, mt{i}), 1, 'first');
493:     if isempty(j)
494:         error('phase5b_production:join', ...
495:             'relay-currents join missed %s %s %s.', mc{i}, ml{i}, mt{i});
496:     end
497:     if isfinite(Jseq(j))
498:         i0 = Jseq(j) * 1000;
499:         src = 'Iseq0-SOURCE-BACKED-Phase-4-production';
500:     elseif strcmp(mt{i}, 'LG')
501:         i0 = Jtot(j) / 3;
502:         src = 'LG-exact-If/3-DERIVED';
503:     else
504:         i0 = NaN;
505:         src = 'MISSING-no-Iseq0-LLG-neutral-counted-once-N/A';
506:     end
507:     if isfinite(Mtrx.I_down_A(i)) && isfinite(Mtrx.ct_down(i))
508:         oLoc{end + 1} = ml{i}; oTyp{end + 1} = mt{i}; oCase{end + 1} = mc{i}; %#ok<AGROW>
509:         oDev{end + 1} = Mtrx.downstream{i}; oSide{end + 1} = 'downstream'; %#ok<AGROW>
510:         oIp(end + 1) = Mtrx.I_down_A(i) * Mtrx.ct_down(i); %#ok<AGROW>
511:         oIk(end + 1) = oIp(end) / 1000; %#ok<AGROW>
512:         oCt(end + 1) = Mtrx.ct_down(i); %#ok<AGROW>
513:         oIs(end + 1) = Mtrx.I_down_A(i); %#ok<AGROW>
514:         oI0(end + 1) = i0; %#ok<AGROW>
515:         oSrc{end + 1} = src; %#ok<AGROW>
516:         oProv{end + 1} = PROV; oScope{end + 1} = 'PRIMARY'; %#ok<AGROW>
517:     end
518:     if isfinite(Mtrx.I_up_A(i)) && isfinite(Mtrx.ct_up(i))
519:         oLoc{end + 1} = ml{i}; oTyp{end + 1} = mt{i}; oCase{end + 1} = mc{i}; %#ok<AGROW>
520:         oDev{end + 1} = Mtrx.upstream{i}; oSide{end + 1} = 'upstream'; %#ok<AGROW>
521:         oIp(end + 1) = Mtrx.I_up_A(i) * Mtrx.ct_up(i); %#ok<AGROW>
522:         oIk(end + 1) = oIp(end) / 1000; %#ok<AGROW>
523:         oCt(end + 1) = Mtrx.ct_up(i); %#ok<AGROW>
524:         oIs(end + 1) = Mtrx.I_up_A(i); %#ok<AGROW>
525:         oI0(end + 1) = i0; %#ok<AGROW>
526:         oSrc{end + 1} = src; %#ok<AGROW>
527:         oProv{end + 1} = PROV; oScope{end + 1} = 'PRIMARY'; %#ok<AGROW>
528:     end
529: end
530: Trc = table(oLoc', oTyp', oCase', oDev', oSide', oIp', oIk', oCt', ...
531:     oIs', oI0', oSrc', oProv', oScope', ...
532:     'VariableNames', {'fault_location', 'fault_type', 'caseID', ...
533:     'device_id', 'side', 'I_primary_A', 'I_primary_kA', 'CT_ratio', ...
534:     'I_secondary_A', 'I0_A', 'I0_source', 'provenance', 'scope'});
535: if height(Trc) < 1
536:     error('phase5b_production:rows', 'relay-currents table empty (matrix sides all missing).');
537: end
538: end

581: function S = sensitivity_v2(T40, devicesProd, Rreg)
582: %SENSITIVITY_V2  v2-adapted GEN-scope sensitivity (C11 BLOCKED fallback).
583: %   The frozen PHASE5_SENSITIVITY is BLOCKED for v2 reuse (never modified):
584: %   it hard-codes the v1 2000 CT on its upstream GSUT leg
585: %   (phase5_sensitivity.m:137 'IsUp = pkUp / 2000', :190 'primUp / 2000',
586: %   :193 reason 'upstream-GSUT-HV-51-2000/1-untouched', comments :9/:11)
587: %   instead of reading device ct_ratio (1600 in v2). Evidence pinned in
588: %   test_phase5b_writer. This engine ports the frozen GEN-scope doctrine
589: %   exactly, reading every pickup/CT/TMS from the v2-resolved devices:
590: %     GEN-51 (phase, all 40 combos) + GEN-51N (earth, LG/LLG only, 20 rows)
591: %     = 60 rows; GEN dial fixed from the PRIMARY scheme via the device CT
592: %     (Is_fixed = P/ct_device, 15000); legacy secondaries via Rreg.ct_legacy
593: %     (16000 fence, read never hard-coded); upstream GSUT-HV-51 backup via
594: %     ITS device CT (1600 — the fix) with the v2-resolved pickup/TMS;
595: %     EF TMS 0.15 from the stamped devices (pickup-resolved, never registry
596: %     0.20). Frozen phase5_ct + phase5_time + phase5_ct_table(T40,16000)
597: %     audit reference only (legacy fence unchanged in v2).
598: %   Relay primaries mirror frozen branch parity: GEN-51 phase -> GEN_Q leg
599: %   else net total; GEN-51N F1/F2 -> 3xI0 neutral-once else LG-exact If/3
600: %   else NaN; GEN-51N F3/F4/F5 -> 3x leg_NER_earth delta block else NaN.
601: %   Verdict doctrine identical to frozen (CTI 0.3 s; NO-TRIP / NO-PAIR /
602: %   NOT DETERMINABLE FROM AVAILABLE DATA). 28 locked cols, scope
603: %   SENSITIVITY, provenance LEGACY-tagged + v2-adaptation note.
604: d51 = finddev(devicesProd, 'GEN-51');
605: d51N = finddev(devicesProd, 'GEN-51N');
606: dUp = finddev(devicesProd, 'GSUT-HV-51');
607: ctGen = read_ct(d51, 'GEN-51');

function [NP, NF] = run_phase5b_tests(varargin)
%RUN_PHASE5B_TESTS  Phase-5b test runner (Phase-5b Task C12).
%   [NP, NF] = RUN_PHASE5B_TESTS() runs every matlab/tests/test_phase5b_*.m
%   suite (discovered via the test_phase5b_ledger anchor on the path, so gap
%   suites are picked up without runner edits) plus the 14-leg

%   passed/failed counts (each validation leg counts one check), and prints
%   'phase5b_tests: NP passed, NF failed'.
%   A suite that errors counts one failure and the runner continues, so one
%   broken suite never hides the rest; the error text stays loud.
%   The frozen v1 runner is never called or modified (see plan global
%   constraints).
%   All errors raised here are 'phase5b'-prefixed.
if nargin ~= 0
    error('phase5b_tests:args', 'usage: [NP, NF] = run_phase5b_tests().');
end
anchor = which('test_phase5b_ledger');
if isempty(anchor)
    error('phase5b_tests:path', 'test_phase5b_ledger not on path (run with addpath(genpath(''matlab''))).');
end

715: dig = md.digest();

717: hex = char(bi.toString(16));

27: %       distinct though values are identical).
28: %
29: %   Magnitudes are in amperes at fault voltage level with the SAME Ibase
30: %   convention as the frozen handoff writer: Ibase = 100/(sqrt(3)*Vlevel) kA
31: %   with Vlevel from loc (F1/F2 22 kV, F3/F4/F5 230 kV); A = |Ipu|*Ibase*1000.
32: %   (The handoff applies the single fault-level Ibase to every leg of the
33: %   row; this module does exactly the same, which is what makes the identity
34: %   gate below satisfiable. Per-leg own-voltage bases are NOT used.)
35: %
36: %   IDENTITY GATE (binding): recomputed |Ia| per (row,leg) must equal the
37: %   production contributions CSV leg value (results/phase4_fault/production/
38: %   phase4_contributions.csv, first stable row per (caseID,location,
39: %   fault_type) among stage Ikpp & m==0.5 -- the same backbone-first
40: %   dedup the phase5_import backbone relies on) within 1e-6 relative
41: %   (rel = |rec-ref|/max(|ref|,1e-30), ref in kA). ANY failure -- numeric
42: %   mismatch, missing production reference row, missing leg column, a finite
43: %   production leg with no recomputed counterpart (omission), or a mismatch
44: %   against the T40-carried import leg value (auxiliary cross-check under the
45: %   same gate: T40 legs ARE the import join of the CSV values, pinned by the
46: %   C5 branch audit, so both references must agree) -- errors
47: %   error('phase5b_branch_phasors:identity', 'BLOCKED ...') listing the first
48: %   failing rows. Loudly BLOCKED, no fallback values, no tolerance widening.
49: %   Downstream C8 then uses NOT-DETERMINABLE for LL/LLG B/C (acceptable
50: %   fallback).
51: %
52: %   Faulted-phase branch magnitude per type (B/C evidence for C8):
53: %     LLL -> max(|Ia|,|Ib|,|Ic|), phase_basis 'maxABC';
54: %     LG  -> |Ia| (A-phase faulted), phase_basis 'Ia';
55: %     LL, LLG -> max(|Ib|,|Ic|) (B/C faulted), phase_basis 'maxBC'.
56: %
57: %   Output B is a table with locked columns (this order):
58: %     caseID, location, fault_type, leg, Ia_A, Ib_A, Ic_A,
59: %     Ibranch_faulted_A, phase_basis.
60: %   One row per (backbone row x present contrib leg). leg names are the raw
61: %   phase4_contrib field names (GEN, GSUT_LV, GSUT_HV, UAT, GAT_HV, GAT_LV,
62: %   LINE_total, LINE_B1, LINE_B2, GRID, NER_earth); absent legs (GAT iff OUT,
63: %   NER_earth unless LG/LLG, LINE_B1/B2 unless F4) are omitted, never
64: %   zero-filled. Subset inputs (fewer rows, same columns) are accepted for
65: %   testing; production use is the full 40-row backbone.
66: %
67: %   All errors are 'phase5b'-prefixed. No existing file is modified; no
68: %   re-solve of Phase-4 defaults is altered (phase4_contrib is called, never
69: %   edited).
70: if nargin ~= 1
71:     error('phase5b_branch_phasors:args', ...
72:         'usage: B = phase5b_branch_phasors(T40).');
73: end
74: if ~istable(T40) || height(T40) < 1
75:     error('phase5b_branch_phasors:schema', ...
76:         'T40 must be a non-empty table (phase5_import backbone).');
77: end
78: if any(strcmp(T40.Properties.VariableNames, 'fault_location'))
79:     locCol = 'fault_location';
80: elseif any(strcmp(T40.Properties.VariableNames, 'location'))
81:     locCol = 'location';
82: else
83:     error('phase5b_branch_phasors:schema', ...
84:         'T40 missing location column (fault_location/location).');
85: end
86: need = {'fault_type', 'caseID'};
87: for k = 1:numel(need)
88:     if ~any(strcmp(T40.Properties.VariableNames, need{k}))
89:         error('phase5b_branch_phasors:schema', ...
90:             'T40 missing required column %s.', need{k});
91:     end
92: end
93: n = height(T40);
94: locs = cell(n, 1);
95: types = cell(n, 1);
96: cases = cell(n, 1);
97: for i = 1:n
98:     lo = T40.(locCol){i};
99:     ty = T40.fault_type{i};
100:     ca = T40.caseID{i};
101:     if isstring(lo) && isscalar(lo), lo = char(lo); end
102:     if isstring(ty) && isscalar(ty), ty = char(ty); end
103:     if isstring(ca) && isscalar(ca), ca = char(ca); end
104:     if ~ischar(lo) || ~any(strcmp(lo, {'F1', 'F2', 'F3', 'F4', 'F5'}))
105:         error('phase5b_branch_phasors:schema', ...
106:             'T40 row %d: unknown location (use F1/F2/F3/F4/F5).', i);
107:     end
108:     if ~ischar(ty) || ~any(strcmp(ty, {'LLL', 'LG', 'LL', 'LLG'}))
109:         error('phase5b_branch_phasors:schema', ...
110:             'T40 row %d: unknown fault_type (use LLL/LG/LL/LLG).', i);
111:     end
112:     if ~ischar(ca) || isempty(strtrim(ca))
113:         error('phase5b_branch_phasors:schema', ...
114:             'T40 row %d: caseID must be non-empty char.', i);
115:     end
116:     locs{i} = lo;
117:     types{i} = ty;
118:     cases{i} = strtrim(ca);
119: end
120: 
121: % --- Production contributions reference (read-only; backbone-first dedup) ---
122: root = ashuganj_root();
123: Fc = fullfile(root, 'results', 'phase4_fault', 'production', ...
124:     'phase4_contributions.csv');
125: if exist(Fc, 'file') ~= 2
126:     error('phase5b_branch_phasors:identity', ...
127:         ['BLOCKED: production contributions CSV missing: ' Fc]);
128: end
129: K = readtable(Fc);
130: Kb = K(strcmp(K.stage, 'Ikpp') & K.m == 0.5, :);
131: kkeys = strcat(Kb.caseID, '|', Kb.location, '|', Kb.fault_type);
132: [~, ika] = unique(kkeys, 'stable');
133: Kb1 = Kb(ika, :);
134: 
135: % --- Recompute + gate ---
136: outCase = cell(0, 1);
137: outLoc = cell(0, 1);
138: outType = cell(0, 1);
139: outLeg = cell(0, 1);
140: outIa = zeros(0, 1);
141: outIb = zeros(0, 1);
142: outIc = zeros(0, 1);
143: outBr = zeros(0, 1);
144: outBasis = cell(0, 1);
145: fail = {};
146: for i = 1:n
147:     lo = locs{i};
148:     ty = types{i};
149:     ca = cases{i};
150:     if any(strcmp(lo, {'F1', 'F2'}))
151:         Vlevel = 22;
152:     else
153:         Vlevel = 230;
154:     end
155:     Ibase = 100 / (sqrt(3) * Vlevel);  % kA, handoff convention
156:     C = phase4_contrib(ca, 'P', 15, lo, ty, 'Ikpp', [], 'bolted');
157:     hit = strcmp(Kb1.caseID, ca) & strcmp(Kb1.location, lo) ...
158:         & strcmp(Kb1.fault_type, ty);
159:     if sum(hit) ~= 1
160:         fail{end+1} = sprintf('row %d %s %s %s: %d production reference rows (want 1)', ...
161:             i, ca, lo, ty, sum(hit)); %#ok<AGROW>
162:         continue;
163:     end
164:     ref = Kb1(find(hit, 1, 'first'), :);
165:     legs = fieldnames(C.legs);
166:     emitted = cell(0, 1);
167:     for q = 1:numel(legs)
168:         leg = legs{q};
169:         L = C.legs.(leg);
170:         aA = abs(L.Ia) * Ibase * 1000;
171:         bA = abs(L.Ib) * Ibase * 1000;
172:         cA = abs(L.Ic) * Ibase * 1000;
173:         switch ty
174:             case 'LLL'
175:                 br = max([aA, bA, cA]);
176:                 basis = 'maxABC';
177:             case 'LG'
178:                 br = aA;
179:                 basis = 'Ia';
180:             otherwise  % LL, LLG: B/C faulted
181:                 br = max(bA, cA);
182:                 basis = 'maxBC';
183:         end
184:         col = ['leg_' leg '_kA'];
185:         if ~any(strcmp(ref.Properties.VariableNames, col))
186:             fail{end+1} = sprintf('row %d %s %s %s leg %s: no production leg column %s', ...
187:                 i, ca, lo, ty, leg, col); %#ok<AGROW>
188:             continue;
189:         end
190:         rv = ref.(col);
191:         if ~isfinite(rv)
192:             fail{end+1} = sprintf('row %d %s %s %s leg %s: production leg value not finite', ...
193:                 i, ca, lo, ty, leg); %#ok<AGROW>
194:             continue;
195:         end
196:         recK = aA / 1000;
197:         if abs(recK - rv) / max(abs(rv), 1e-30) > 1e-6
198:             fail{end+1} = sprintf(['row %d %s %s %s leg %s: recomputed |Ia| %.12g kA vs ' ...
199:                 'production %.12g kA (rel %.3g > 1e-6)'], ...
200:                 i, ca, lo, ty, leg, recK, rv, ...
201:                 abs(recK - rv) / max(abs(rv), 1e-30)); %#ok<AGROW>
202:             continue;
203:         end
204:         if any(strcmp(T40.Properties.VariableNames, col))
205:             tv = T40.(col)(i);  % leg columns are numeric (phase5_import join)
206:             if isfinite(tv) && abs(recK - tv) / max(abs(tv), 1e-30) > 1e-6
207:                 fail{end+1} = sprintf(['row %d %s %s %s leg %s: recomputed |Ia| %.12g kA vs ' ...
208:                     'T40-carried %.12g kA (rel %.3g > 1e-6)'], ...
209:                     i, ca, lo, ty, leg, recK, tv, ...
210:                     abs(recK - tv) / max(abs(tv), 1e-30)); %#ok<AGROW>
211:                 continue;
212:             end
213:         end
214:         outCase{end+1, 1} = ca; %#ok<AGROW>
215:         outLoc{end+1, 1} = lo; %#ok<AGROW>
216:         outType{end+1, 1} = ty; %#ok<AGROW>
217:         outLeg{end+1, 1} = leg; %#ok<AGROW>
218:         outIa(end+1, 1) = aA; %#ok<AGROW>
219:         outIb(end+1, 1) = bA; %#ok<AGROW>
220:         outIc(end+1, 1) = cA; %#ok<AGROW>
221:         outBr(end+1, 1) = br; %#ok<AGROW>
222:         outBasis{end+1, 1} = basis; %#ok<AGROW>
223:         emitted{end+1, 1} = leg; %#ok<AGROW>
224:     end
225:     % Omission guard: every finite production leg must have been emitted.
226:     vn = ref.Properties.VariableNames;
227:     for q = 1:numel(vn)
228:         tok = regexp(char(vn{q}), '^leg_(.+)_kA$', 'tokens', 'once');
229:         if isempty(tok)
230:             continue;
231:         end
232:         if isfinite(ref.(vn{q})) && ~any(strcmp(emitted, tok{1}))
233:             fail{end+1} = sprintf('row %d %s %s %s leg %s: finite production leg omitted', ...
234:                 i, ca, lo, ty, tok{1}); %#ok<AGROW>
235:         end
236:     end
237: end
238: if ~isempty(fail)
239:     nshow = min(numel(fail), 10);
240:     error('phase5b_branch_phasors:identity', ...
241:         ['BLOCKED: identity gate failed on %d (row,leg) checks (tolerance 1e-6 relative, ' ...
242:          'no fallback values). First %d: %s'], ...
243:         numel(fail), nshow, strjoin(fail(1:nshow), ' | '));
244: end
245: 
246: B = table(outCase, outLoc, outType, outLeg, outIa, outIb, outIc, outBr, outBasis, ...
247:     'VariableNames', {'caseID', 'location', 'fault_type', 'leg', 'Ia_A', ...
248:     'Ib_A', 'Ic_A', 'Ibranch_faulted_A', 'phase_basis'});
249: end
